verdict.rationale: Fern has a public GitHub repository (fern-api/fern) where its source can be read, and a community comment calls Fern "open-source, though not free." The pack never names the license or says which components are open versus proprietary hosted parts, and that "not free" remark suggests not all of the product is open. Missing for 10: an explicitly named open license (e.g., MIT or Apache-2.0), first-party documentation of licensing terms, and clarity on which parts of the platform (docs hosting, Ask Fern, Fern Agent) are open source.
